exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Did you learn to swim when you were a child? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: How often do you go swimming now? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: What places are there for swimming where you live? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you think it would be more enjoyable to go swimming outdoors or at an indoor pool? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a famous business person that you know about. You should say: who this person is what kind of business this person is involved in what you know about this business person and explain what you think of this business person.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What kinds of people are most famous in your country today?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why are there so many stories about famous people in the news?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you agree or disagree that many young people today want to be famous?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you think it is easy for famous people to earn a lot of money?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Why might famous people enjoy having fans?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: In what ways could famous people use their influence to do good things in the world?
